normalize_text: normalize a string by replacing Unicode control characters, hyphens, quotes, and slashes with ASCII equivalents
normalize_hyphens_and_dashes: normalize text to replace all Unicode hyphen and dash variants with a standard ASCII hyphen
normalize_quotes: normalize text to replace curly quotes, primes, and apostrophes with standard ASCII single and double quotes
remove_control_characters: normalize text to strip non-printable Unicode control characters from a string
normalize_slashes: normalize text to replace fraction slash and division slash variants with a standard ASCII forward slash
